extracted.intended_audience: Wikipedia readers and prospective article creators / new contributors
extracted.subtask_description: Guidance for finding, creating, or troubleshooting a missing Wikipedia article title (searching for alternatives, account requirements, redirects, and deletion checks).

rubrics_metrics.name: Search for alternative titles or spellings
rubrics_metrics.description: Please search for Gutfeld show in Wikipedia to check for alternative titles or spellings.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the site's search box to find similar or variant titles before creating a new page; check alternative capitalizations and spellings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check for existing links to the title
rubrics_metrics.description: Look for pages within Wikipedia that link to this title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inspect backlinks to see whether the topic is mentioned elsewhere or covered under a different article/title; this can indicate whether a new article is needed or a redirect is appropriate.

rubrics_metrics.name: Account and autoconfirmed requirement to create articles
rubrics_metrics.description: You need to log in or create an account and be autoconfirmed to create new articles.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you don't meet account/autoconfirmed status, use alternative submission paths (article wizard or request a new article) rather than creating a page directly.

rubrics_metrics.name: Use the article wizard or request a new article as alternatives
rubrics_metrics.description: Alternatively, you can use the article wizard to submit a draft for review, or request a new article.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: New or unautoconfirmed contributors should submit drafts via the article wizard or ask for a new article through the appropriate request process to get community review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Newly created pages may be temporarily invisible
rubrics_metrics.description: If a page was recently created here, it may not be visible yet because of a delay in updating the database; wait a few minutes or try the purge function.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If a recently created page doesn't appear, allow time for propagation or use the purge function to refresh; don't assume deletion immediately.

rubrics_metrics.name: Title case-sensitivity and redirect consideration
rubrics_metrics.description: Titles on Wikipedia are case sensitive except for the first character; please check alternative capitalizations and consider adding a redirect here to the correct title.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Before creating a new page, verify capitalization variants and, if appropriate, create redirects so readers find the correct article regardless of minor title differences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Check the deletion log if a page may have been removed
rubrics_metrics.description: If the page has been deleted, check the deletion log, and see Why was the page I created deleted?
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Review deletion records and the listed reasons to understand whether a topic was removed for policy reasons; follow guidance in the deletion explanation to address issues if you plan to recreate content.
